concept.title: Perpetuity
concept.shortdesc: Equity capital is for perpetuity. It cannot be redeemed and the company does not have

conbody.p: Equity capital is for perpetuity. It cannot be redeemed and the company does not have an obligation to repay it. In special situations, a company may buy-back its own shares from the shareholders. Such shares shall be extinguished by the company.
